embeds.label: Saved embeds
embeds.description: Build messages with an embed and link buttons, post them in any channel and edit the posted message whenever you like. Saved embeds are shared with /embed and the Automations module.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A short unique name for this embed, also used by /embed in Discord. It cannot be changed later.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: The text, embed and link buttons. Variables like {server} are filled in when the message is posted; {user} is you. Saving changes also updates the posted message.

readOnly.label: Status
readOnly.description: Draft, or posted in a channel.

readOnly.label: Channel
readOnly.description: Where the message is posted (for a draft: where it was last posted).

actions.label: Post in a channel
actions.description: Posts the message in a channel. If it is already posted, the new copy becomes the one that is kept up to date.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: A text or announcement channel the bot can post in.

fields.label: Delete the previous copy
fields.description: When the embed is already posted somewhere, delete that message (move it). Off: the old message stays but is no longer updated.

actions.label: Update posted message
actions.description: Applies the saved message to the posted copy again, e.g. after the server name changed or a missing permission was fixed.

actions.label: Delete posted message
actions.description: Deletes the posted message from Discord. The saved embed stays as a draft you can post again.
actions.confirm: Delete the posted message from Discord? The saved embed stays as a draft.

tags.label: Custom commands
tags.description: Commands members run with the server prefix (!name) or /tag use: replies with random variations, DMs, messages to other channels and roles to give or take, with access rules and cooldowns.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Members type it after the prefix, e.g. rules for !rules. Lowercase letters, numbers, - and _. It cannot be changed later.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown in /help and /tag list.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: the command does not answer.

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: What the command does, in order (up to 5). Replies support variables and arguments such as {1}.

itemFields.label: Replies
itemFields.description: Reply, DM and send actions: one of these is picked at random each time.

itemFields.label: Reply
itemFields.description: Up to 2,000 characters, or 4,000 when sent as an embed.

itemFields.label: Send as an embed
itemFields.description: Reply, DM and send actions only.

itemFields.label: Channel
itemFields.description: "Send to a channel" only: where the message goes.

itemFields.label: Role
itemFields.description: Role actions only. It must be below the bot's highest role and carry no moderator permissions.

itemFields.label: Roles the message may ping
itemFields.description: Reply and send actions: role mentions in the text only ping these roles. DMs never ping.

fields.label: Allowed roles
fields.description: Only members with one of these roles may use it. Empty: everyone.

fields.label: Denied roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles may not use it.

fields.label: Allowed channels
fields.description: Only works in these channels or categories. Empty: everywhere.

fields.label: Denied channels
fields.description: Never works in these channels or categories.

fields.label: Cooldown length
fields.description: How long before it can be used again (up to 365 days).

fields.label: Delete the !name message
fields.description: Deletes the member's message after the command ran (prefix use only; the bot needs Manage Messages).

triggers.label: Auto-responders
triggers.description: Automatic replies to messages that contain a keyword or match a pattern. They answer while the Custom Commands module and its auto-responder switch are on.

fields.label: Keyword or pattern
fields.description: The word, phrase or regular expression to watch for.

fields.label: Response
fields.description: The reply. Variables such as {user} and {channel} work.

fields.label: Cooldown per member
fields.description: How long one member waits before it answers them again (0 = no cooldown).

fields.label: Delete the matching message
fields.description: The bot needs Manage Messages for this.

fields.label: Only in these channels
fields.description: Empty: every channel. Threads count as their parent channel.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: paused, the settings are kept.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.description: Messages the bot posts on a schedule: at a time of day, every few minutes or hours, or once. Times of day use the server time zone from the General settings.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A short unique name, also used by /reminder in Discord. It cannot be changed later.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where the reminder is posted.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Server and channel variables work. Reminders have no member, so {user} variables are posted as written.

fields.label: Time of day
fields.description: "At a time of day": when it is posted, in the server time zone.

fields.label: Days
fields.description: "At a time of day" and "Every interval": the days it runs on. None selected: every day.

fields.label: Interval
fields.description: "Every interval": time between posts, 5 minutes to 7 days (10080 minutes).

fields.label: Daily start
fields.description: "Every interval": only post from this time of day (needs an interval under 24 hours). Empty: from midnight.

fields.label: Daily stop
fields.description: "Every interval": stop posting at this time of day. Empty: until midnight.

fields.label: Date and time
fields.description: "Once": when it is posted (within one year).

fields.label: Skip when the channel is quiet
fields.description: Not posted unless someone chatted since the last reminder (not for "Once").

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned at the start of every reminder.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: paused, nothing is posted.

actions.label: Send a test
actions.description: Posts the reminder once now as a preview. Roles are not pinged and the schedule is not touched.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where to post the test. Empty: the reminder's channel.

feeds.label: Social feeds
feeds.description: Post new RSS items, YouTube uploads, Reddit posts, Bluesky posts and podcast episodes in a channel. Each feed is checked every 5 to 30 minutes; only items published after it was added are posted.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: RSS: the feed URL or a site that links to its feed. YouTube: the UC… channel ID or a youtube.com/channel/UC… link (@handles are not supported). Reddit: the subreddit, e.g. r/aww. Bluesky: a handle, profile link or DID. Podcast: its name to search for, or its RSS feed URL. It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where new items are posted.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned with every new item.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Empty: the default message for this kind of feed. Variables: {title} {link} {author} {feed}, plus {youtube_channel} (YouTube), {subreddit} (Reddit), {bluesky_name} {bluesky_handle} (Bluesky), {podcast_title} {episode_title} (podcasts). Feeds have no member, so {user} variables do not work.

fields.label: Include reposts
fields.description: Bluesky only: also post reposts.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: paused, the settings are kept. Turning it back on resets its failures; items published while it was off are skipped.

actions.label: Check now
actions.description: Fetches the feed once and shows its newest item. Nothing is posted or changed.

levelRoles.label: Level rewards
levelRoles.description: Roles members earn when they reach a level. Adding a reward does not give the role to members who are already past that level: run /levelconfig role sync in Discord for that. Members who already have a role keep it when you remove its reward. Whether lower rewards are kept is set under "Keep lower reward roles".

fields.label: Level
fields.description: Members get the role as soon as they reach this level. Each level has one reward.

fields.label: Reward role
fields.description: The role the bot gives. It must be below the bot's highest role, and each role can be the reward for one level only.

readOnly.label: Reward
readOnly.description: The level this reward is for.

shopItems.label: Shop items
shopItems.description: What members can buy with /shop buy. Deleting an item also deletes every copy members own. Role items need a role the bot can give (it must be below the bot's highest role).

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in /shop and used to pick the item. Unique on this server (upper and lower case count as the same).

fields.label: Price
fields.description: What one copy costs, in the server currency.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Collectible items just sit in the inventory. Usable items are used with /use. Role items give a role.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: The role a Role item gives. Only for Role items; it must be below the bot's highest role.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown in the shop.

fields.label: Image link
fields.description: A picture shown with the item (an http or https link).

fields.label: Use on purchase
fields.description: The item is used the moment it is bought. Not for collectible items.

fields.label: Used up on use
fields.description: Each use removes one copy from the inventory.

fields.label: Allow several copies
fields.description: Members may own more than one copy (up to the limit below). Off: one per member.

fields.label: Copies per member
fields.description: The most copies one member may own.

fields.label: Stock
fields.description: Copies left for sale. Empty means unlimited; 0 means sold out.

fields.label: Purchase message
fields.description: Shown after a purchase. Empty uses the default message.

fields.label: Use message
fields.description: Shown after the item is used. Empty uses the default message.

fields.label: In the shop
fields.description: Off hides the item from /shop and stops purchases. Copies members own are kept.

achievements.label: Achievements
achievements.description: Goals members work towards (messages, reactions, levels, boosts, purchases), with up to four tiers and rewards. Deleting an achievement deletes every member's progress on it; roles, XP and coins already given are kept. The bot picks up changes within about 30 seconds.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique on this server (upper and lower case count as the same).

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Short text shown in /achievements.

fields.label: Badge
fields.description: One emoji shown next to the name. Empty uses the default badge of the trigger. A custom emoji must come from a server the bot is in.

fields.label: What members do
fields.description: What counts as progress. Cannot be changed later. Level achievements need the Levels module, purchase achievements the Economy module.

fields.label: Tiers
fields.description: Up to four goals, lowest first: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond. Members unlock a tier when they reach its goal and get its rewards. Tiers are matched by position when you change them: removing the last tier keeps rewards already given, and members who already passed a lowered goal unlock it with their next activity.

itemFields.label: Goal
itemFields.description: What a member has to reach for this tier. Goals go up from tier to tier.

itemFields.label: Give this role
itemFields.description: Reward: a role the bot gives. It must be below the bot's highest role.

itemFields.label: Take this role away
itemFields.description: Reward: a role the bot removes. It must be below the bot's highest role.

itemFields.label: XP reward
itemFields.description: Reward: XP. Needs the Levels module to be on.

itemFields.label: Coin reward
itemFields.description: Reward: coins. Needs the Economy module to be on.

fields.label: Count past activity
fields.description: Off: members start from zero when the achievement is created. Only applies to members who have no progress yet.

fields.label: Deadline
fields.description: The last moment members can make progress (between a minute and five years from now). Empty means no deadline.

fields.label: On
fields.description: Off: nothing is counted until you turn it back on. Progress is kept.

readOnly.label: Members with progress
readOnly.description: How many members have started this achievement.

starboards.label: Starboards
starboards.description: Boards that repost popular messages to a channel. Deleting a board keeps its reposts, but they stop updating. The bot picks up changes within about a minute.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32). Unique on this server.
fields.patternMessage: The name may only use lowercase letters a-z, digits, - and _.

fields.label: Repost channel
fields.description: Where popular messages are reposted. Changing it reposts live entries into the new channel; old reposts stay where they are.

fields.label: Emojis that count
fields.description: Reactions that count towards the threshold: an emoji, or a custom emoji as <:name:id> or just its ID. Empty means every emoji counts.

fields.label: Reactions needed
fields.description: How many counting reactions a message needs to be reposted.

fields.label: Count the author's own reaction
fields.description: Off: a member reacting to their own message does not count.

fields.label: Remove the author's own reaction
fields.description: The bot removes a member's own qualifying reaction (needs Manage Messages). Cannot be combined with counting it.

fields.label: Ignore bots
fields.description: Ignore messages from bots and reactions by bots.

fields.label: Remove the repost below the threshold
fields.description: Delete the repost when the message falls below the threshold again.

fields.label: React to the repost
fields.description: The bot adds the first counting emoji to the repost (needs Add Reactions and Read Message History).

fields.label: Ignore older messages
fields.description: Messages older than this many days are never reposted. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Repost from age-restricted channels
fields.description: The repost channel must be age-restricted too.

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Messages in these channels (or categories) never reach this board.

fields.label: On
fields.description: Off: nothing is reposted by this board.

readOnly.label: Live reposts
readOnly.description: Messages this board currently has reposted.

translateChannels.label: Translated channels
translateChannels.description: Channels where the bot translates every message. Adding the first channel also turns the Auto-Translate module on, like /autotranslate does. Deleting a channel here only stops the translating. The bot picks up changes within about 30 seconds.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Messages posted here are translated by the bot. Text, announcement, voice and stage channels (their chat) work; threads are set up with /autotranslate in Discord.

fields.label: Translate into
fields.description: Up to five languages. Every message is translated into each of them (the bot posts a reply with the translations).

translateStats.label: Channels by translation activity
translateStats.description: Per channel: how many messages were translated (auto-translate replies and /translate), the languages members write in and the languages they were translated into. Only counts are kept, never the messages.

readOnly.label: Members write in
readOnly.description: The language of each translated message, as the translation service detected it.

tempVoiceHubs.label: Voice hubs
tempVoiceHubs.description: Join-to-create voice channels. Deleting a hub here only removes its settings and is refused while its temporary channels are open; the hub channel itself stays in Discord (use /voice-hub delete to remove channels too). The bot notices new, changed and deleted hubs within about 5 minutes.

fields.label: Hub channel
fields.description: The voice channel members join to get their own channel. Pick an existing voice channel; this page cannot create one (/voice-hub create can do that in Discord). It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Category for new channels
fields.description: Where the temporary channels are created. Empty uses the hub channel's own category.

fields.label: Channel name
fields.description: The name of each new channel. {index} is the channel number and {username} the owner's name. Mentions such as {user} are not allowed.

fields.label: User limit
fields.description: How many members fit in a new channel. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Bitrate
fields.description: Audio quality of new channels. Empty uses Discord's default. The server's boost level caps it.

fields.label: Keep empty channels
fields.description: How long an empty channel survives before it is deleted. 0 deletes it at once.

fields.label: Ownership lock
fields.description: How long after the owner leaves before someone else can claim the channel with /voice claim. 0 means at once.

fields.label: Copy the category's permissions
fields.description: On: new channels copy the category's permissions. Off: they copy the hub channel's.

fields.label: Create a text channel too
fields.description: Each new voice channel gets a companion text channel.

fields.label: Text channel only for voice members
fields.description: Only members currently in the voice channel can see its text channel.

fields.label: Protected roles
fields.description: /voice commands do not affect members with these roles: they cannot be kicked or banned, and locking or hiding does not shut them out.

fields.label: Moderator roles
fields.description: Members with these roles can use every /voice command on any channel from this hub.

readOnly.label: Open channels
readOnly.description: Temporary channels from this hub that exist right now.

statChannels.label: Counter channels
statChannels.description: Voice channels renamed about every 10 minutes to show a live number (members, online, boosts, ...). Discord allows only a few renames per channel, so a name can lag a few minutes. Deleting a counter here only stops the updates; the channel stays in Discord with its last name. Channels that /stats create makes (locked for @everyone) can be edited and deleted here.

fields.label: What to count
fields.description: The number the channel name shows. Cannot be changed later. Only the Online and Peak online counters need the bot to see presences.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: An existing voice channel that the bot renames. Pick a dedicated one: its name is replaced. Deny Connect for @everyone on it so nobody joins (/stats create in Discord does that for you). It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Role to count
fields.description: Only for "Role members": whose members are counted. The role is only counted, never given. Cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Channel name
fields.description: The channel name; {count} is replaced by the number ({role} by the role name for "Role members"). Empty uses the default for the counter type, e.g. "Members: {count}".

readOnly.label: Showing
readOnly.description: The number in the channel name at the last update.

readOnly.label: Peak
readOnly.description: The highest online count seen (Peak online only).

actions.label: Update the counters now
actions.description: Asks the bot to update every counter channel of this server within about a minute (/stats refresh). Discord still limits how often a channel can be renamed, so a name can lag a few minutes. The Statistics Channels module must be on.

economyBoosts.label: Coin boosts
economyBoosts.description: A boost multiplies one /daily or /work payout for a member who holds its role (or for everyone). Only the highest boost a member has not used up in the current period applies. Rewards, /pay, casino winnings and admin grants are never boosted.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique on this server (upper and lower case count as the same).

fields.label: Bonus
fields.description: Extra coins in percent: 50 turns a payout of 100 coins into 150.

fields.label: How often one member can use it
fields.description: One-time: once per member, ever. The others: once per day, ISO week or month in the server time zone. Cannot be changed later; delete the boost and create a new one for that.

fields.label: Only members with this role
fields.description: Leave empty so every member qualifies. The role is only checked, never given.

fields.label: On
fields.description: A boost that is off is ignored. Its usage history is kept.

readOnly.label: Times used
readOnly.description: How many times members have used this boost so far.

cases.label: Moderation cases
cases.description: Every moderation action in this server, newest first. A new case warns, times out, kicks, softbans, bans or unbans someone exactly like the slash commands: the member gets a DM when that is on, the case is posted in the case log and warnings count towards your automatic punishments. Nothing is posted in a chat channel. Cases cannot be deleted; "Clear warnings" pardons all of a member's active warnings.
cases.searchPlaceholder: Search by member name, user ID or case number

fields.label: Action
fields.description: What to do. The same rules as the slash commands apply: your highest role must be above theirs and immune members are protected.

options.label: Warn
options.description: Records a warning and DMs the member (/warn). Warnings can trigger your automatic punishments.

options.label: Timeout
options.description: Times the member out (/timeout). Over 28 days uses the mute role, when one is set.

options.label: Remove timeout or mute
options.description: Removes the member's timeout and mute role (/unmute).

options.label: Kick
options.description: Kicks the member (/kick). They can rejoin with an invite.

options.label: Softban
options.description: Bans and immediately unbans to delete their recent messages (/softban).

options.label: Ban
options.description: Bans the user, also when they already left (/ban). Give a duration for a temporary ban.

options.label: Unban
options.description: Lifts a ban (/unban).

fields.label: Member
fields.description: Who to act on. Bans and unbans also work for users who are not in the server: paste their user ID.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Kept with the case, written to the audit log and sent in the DM. Required for a warning; up to 512 characters (1,000 when you edit it later, like /case reason).

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: How long, e.g. 10m, 2h, 7d or 1mo. A timeout needs one (over 28 days uses the mute role); leave it empty for a permanent ban.

fields.label: Delete their recent messages
fields.description: Days of their messages to delete, 0 to 7.

fields.label: Delete their recent messages
fields.description: Days of their messages to delete, 1 to 7.

fields.label: Proof link
fields.description: An http(s) link to evidence, kept with the case. It can be replaced later but not removed (like /case proof).

actions.label: Clear warnings
actions.description: Pardons all of this case's member's active warnings, like /case clear-history (administrators only). Their cases stay in the history, and escalation counting starts over.
actions.confirm: Pardon every active warning of this case's member? Their cases stay in the history.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why the warnings are cleared (kept in the pardon note).

levels.label: Member levels
levels.description: The XP leaderboard of this server. Give, remove or set XP and reset members like /levelconfig xp does: reward roles follow the new level and no level-up message is posted. This works while the Levels module is off. Giving XP to every member of a role is only available with /levelconfig xp give in Discord.
levels.searchPlaceholder: Search by member name or user ID

fields.label: Member
fields.description: The member who gets the XP. Bots never earn XP.

fields.label: XP to give
fields.description: Added to their total (at most 1,000,000 at a time). Reward roles follow the new level; no level-up message is posted.

actions.label: Give XP
actions.description: Adds XP to this member (like /levelconfig xp give).

fields.label: XP to give
fields.description: At most 1,000,000 at a time.

actions.label: Remove XP
actions.description: Takes XP from this member, never below 0 (like /levelconfig xp remove).

fields.label: XP to remove
fields.description: At most 1,000,000 at a time.

actions.label: Set XP
actions.description: Sets this member's total XP (like /levelconfig xp set).

actions.label: Reset XP
actions.description: Wipes this member's XP and level (like /levelconfig xp reset).
actions.confirm: Reset this member's XP and level to zero? This cannot be undone.

balances.label: Member balances
balances.description: Every member's coins on this server, richest first. Give, remove or set coins and reset members like /economy-admin does: balances never go above the server's maximum balance, and a member's first balance here starts from their old global balance unless that import is turned off. This works while the Economy module is off.
balances.searchPlaceholder: Search by member name or user ID

fields.label: Member
fields.description: Who gets the coins. Bots cannot hold coins.

fields.label: Coins to give
fields.description: Added to their balance, never above the server's maximum balance.

readOnly.label: Rank
readOnly.description: Members with the same balance share a rank.

actions.label: Give coins
actions.description: Adds coins to this member's balance (like /economy-admin coins give).

fields.label: Coins to give
fields.description: Never above the server's maximum balance.

actions.label: Remove coins
actions.description: Takes coins from this member, never below 0 (like /economy-admin coins remove).

fields.label: Coins to remove
fields.description: If they have fewer, their balance becomes 0.

actions.label: Set balance
actions.description: Sets this member's balance (like /economy-admin coins set).

fields.label: New balance
fields.description: From 0 to the server's maximum balance.

actions.label: Reset
actions.description: Resets this member's coins and/or items (like /economy-admin reset member:).

options.label: Coins
options.description: Their balance goes back to the starting balance; their daily streak and cooldowns are cleared.

options.label: Items
options.description: Every item in their inventory is removed. Shop items stay.

options.label: Coins and items
options.description: Both of the above.

giveaways.label: Giveaways
giveaways.description: Giveaways with a Participate button, the same as /giveaway in Discord. Running and draft ones come first, then the finished ones. Up to 100 can be running at once. Only the bonus odds can be changed after it is posted. Starting and ending run in the bot, so they can take a few seconds.

fields.label: Prize
fields.description: What the winners get. Shown as the title of the giveaway.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Extra text shown in the giveaway message. Optional.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where the giveaway is posted. The bot needs to view the channel and send messages, embeds and message history there.

fields.label: Winners
fields.description: How many winners are drawn, 1 to 90.

fields.label: Length
fields.description: How long it runs, like 30m, 2h, 3d or 1w (1 minute to 90 days). Fill in this or the end time, not both.

fields.label: End time
fields.description: Or the exact moment it ends (up to 90 days away). Fill in this or the length, not both.

fields.label: Required roles
fields.description: Members must have all of these roles to enter. Leave empty for everyone.

fields.label: Blocked roles
fields.description: Members with any of these roles cannot enter.

fields.label: Bonus odds
fields.description: Members with one of these roles count as several entries when the winners are drawn (the highest matching role counts). This is the one thing you can still change while a giveaway is running or in drafts.

itemFields.label: Entries
itemFields.description: How many entries each member of the role counts as.

fields.label: XP for each winner
fields.description: Paid out through the Levels module when the giveaway ends. Needs that module to be on.

fields.label: Coins for each winner
fields.description: Paid out through the Economy module when the giveaway ends. Needs that module to be on.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned when the giveaway is posted. The role must be mentionable, or the bot and you need Mention @everyone, @here and All Roles in the channel.

fields.label: Colour
fields.description: Colour of the giveaway message while it runs. Empty: the server colour.

actions.label: End now
actions.description: Draws the winners now, announces them and pays the XP and coin prizes. Same as /giveaway end.
actions.confirm: End this giveaway now and draw its winners?

actions.label: Reroll
actions.description: Draws new winners of an ended giveaway. Earlier winners keep their prize. Same as /giveaway reroll.

fields.label: New winners
fields.description: How many more winners to draw.

actions.label: Restart
actions.description: Posts a draft giveaway (its message was deleted) again. The entries are kept. Same as /giveaway restart.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where to post it again. Empty: the original channel.

fields.label: New length
fields.description: Like 30m, 2h or 3d. Leave both empty to keep the old end time (needs at least a minute left).

fields.label: New end time
fields.description: Or the exact moment it ends. Use either this or the length.

actions.label: Cancel giveaway
actions.description: Stops a running or draft giveaway without drawing winners. Same as /giveaway cancel.
actions.confirm: Cancel this giveaway? No winners will be drawn and this cannot be undone.

polls.label: Polls
polls.description: Polls with vote buttons or a menu, the same as /poll in Discord. Active ones come first, then the finished ones. Up to 50 can be active at once. A posted poll cannot be edited. Posting and ending run in the bot, so they can take a few seconds.

fields.label: Question
fields.description: Shown as the title of the poll.

fields.label: Options
fields.description: 2 to 20 answers, each up to 80 characters. Members vote with a button (one choice) or a menu (several choices).

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where the poll is posted. The bot needs to view the channel and send messages and embeds there.

fields.label: Choices per member
fields.description: 1: one answer per member (buttons). More: each member can pick up to that many answers (a menu). It is lowered to the number of options when there are fewer.

fields.label: Length
fields.description: How long it runs, like 30m, 2h or 3d (1 minute to 30 days). Empty: until someone ends it.

fields.label: Only these roles can vote
fields.description: Leave empty so everyone can vote.

fields.label: These roles cannot vote
fields.description: Members with any of these roles cannot vote, even if they also have an allowed role.

fields.label: Hide results until it ends
fields.description: Members see no counts while the poll is active. You can always see them here.

actions.label: End now
actions.description: Closes the poll and posts the results in its channel. Same as /poll end.
actions.confirm: End this poll now and post the results?

reactionRoles.label: Reaction role panels
reactionRoles.description: Saving a panel posts it in its channel or updates its message, and deleting it deletes the message too. Panels made with /reactionrole attach stay attached: the bot never edits or deletes their message.

fields.label: Template
fields.description: Start from a ready-made panel. A template creates its roles for you (or reuses ones with the same name); edit the panel afterwards to remove the ones you do not need.

options.label: Pronouns (5 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) He/Him, She/Her, They/Them, Any Pronouns, Ask My Pronouns and posts them as a Normal button panel.

options.label: Colors (10 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Light Blue, Blue, Purple, Pink, Brown, Grey and posts them as a Unique dropdown.

options.label: Age groups (5 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) 13-17, 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45+ and posts them as a Unique button panel.

options.label: Regions (7 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Middle East, Asia, Oceania and posts them as a Unique button panel.

options.label: Gaming platforms (5 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Mobile and posts them as a Normal button panel.

options.label: DM status (3 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) DMs Open, Ask to DM, DMs Closed and posts them as a Unique button panel.

options.label: Ping roles (5 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) Announcements, Events, Giveaways, Polls, Streams and posts them as a Normal button panel.

options.label: Timezones: US (10 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) SST, HST, AKST, PST, MST (AZ), MST, CST, EST, AST (PR), ChST, links each to its time zone for /timestamp, and posts them as a Unique dropdown.

options.label: Timezones: worldwide (24 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) HST, AKST, PST, MST (AZ), MST, CST (MX), CST, EST, AST (PR), AST, BRT, GMT, CET, EET, MSK, GST, PKT, IST, ICT, SGT, JST, ChST, AEST, NZST, links each to its time zone for /timestamp, and posts them as a Unique dropdown.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where the panel is posted. Use "Repost" to move it later.

fields.label: Layout
fields.description: How members pick roles.

fields.label: Role mode
fields.description: Normal: get and remove roles. Unique: one role at a time. Verify: get roles only. Reverse: using a role removes it.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The heading of the panel (up to 256 characters).

fields.label: Text under the title
fields.description: Shown in the embed under the title. Empty: a default text for the layout.

fields.label: Message text
fields.description: Plain text sent with the panel, up to 2000 characters.

fields.label: Text only (no embed)
fields.description: Send the panel as plain text instead of an embed.

fields.label: Most roles per member
fields.description: Normal mode only. Empty: no limit.

fields.label: Dropdown placeholder
fields.description: Dropdown panels only: the text shown before a member picks, up to 150 characters. Empty: a default.

fields.label: Roles
fields.description: In this order. Buttons and dropdowns hold up to 25 roles, emoji reactions up to 20. Roles with moderator or admin permissions can only be added with /reactionrole add in Discord, which asks you to confirm.
fields.emptyText: No roles yet. Add the roles members can pick.

itemFields.label: Role
itemFields.description: The role members get, below the bot's highest role and yours.

itemFields.label: Label
itemFields.description: Button text or dropdown label, up to 80 characters. Empty: the role name.

itemFields.label: Emoji
itemFields.description: Required on emoji-reaction panels (each emoji once). A standard emoji or one of this server's emojis.

itemFields.label: Button colour
itemFields.description: Button panels only.

itemFields.label: Dropdown description
itemFields.description: Dropdown panels only, up to 100 characters.

readOnly.label: Status
readOnly.description: Posted, not posted yet (use "Repost"), message deleted in Discord (use "Repost"), or an attached message.

actions.label: Repost
actions.description: Posts the panel again, in another channel or after its message was deleted, and deletes the old message. An attached panel without a channel only gets its reactions back.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: A text or announcement channel the bot can post in. Empty: the panel's own channel.

ticketPanels.label: Ticket panels
ticketPanels.description: Saving a panel updates its published message, and deleting it deletes the message too (open tickets keep their channels). Publishing, categories, the transcript channel and manager roles need the bot to be online.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A name for this panel, unique on the server (up to 50 characters).

fields.label: Style
fields.description: Members open a ticket with buttons or with a dropdown menu.

fields.label: Publish in channel
fields.description: Where the panel message is posted; pick another channel to move it. Empty: not published yet.

fields.label: Panel message
fields.description: The message with the buttons or dropdown. Link buttons are not used here. Empty: the default "How can we help?".

embed.title: How can we help?
embed.description: Press a button below to open a private ticket with our team.

fields.label: Options
fields.description: The buttons or dropdown entries, in this order. A panel keeps at least one.

itemFields.label: Label
itemFields.description: The button text or dropdown entry, up to 80 characters. Each label once per panel.

itemFields.label: Emoji
itemFields.description: A standard emoji or one of this server's custom emojis.

itemFields.label: Dropdown description
itemFields.description: Dropdown panels only, up to 100 characters.

itemFields.label: Button colour
itemFields.description: Button panels only.

itemFields.label: Category for this option
itemFields.description: Tickets of this option open here. Empty: the panel's open category.

itemFields.label: Intro message for this option
itemFields.description: Posted in tickets of this option. Empty: the panel's intro message.

itemFields.label: Option ID
itemFields.description: Internal. Identifies an existing option when you edit the list.

fields.label: Ticket manager roles
fields.description: Roles that can see and handle this panel's tickets (moderators and admins always can). Existing tickets get access too.

fields.label: Ticket intro message
fields.description: Posted when a ticket opens, with Close and Claim buttons. {managers} pings the manager roles. Empty: the default intro.

embed.title: Ticket #{number}
embed.description:
Thanks for reaching out, {user.display_name}! A member of our team will be with you shortly.
Please describe your issue in as much detail as you can.

fields.label: Open tickets category
fields.description: Where new tickets are created (the bot needs View Channel, Manage Channels and Manage Roles there). Empty: the bot creates a "Tickets" category when needed.

fields.label: Claimed tickets category
fields.description: Where a claimed ticket moves. Empty: the bot creates "Claimed Tickets" when needed.

fields.label: Closed tickets category
fields.description: Where a closed ticket moves. Empty: the bot creates "Closed Tickets" when needed.

fields.label: Transcript channel
fields.description: Where the HTML transcript is posted when a ticket is deleted (the bot needs Send Messages, Embed Links and Attach Files). Empty: none.

fields.label: Send the transcript to the member
fields.description: Also DM the transcript to the member who opened the ticket.

fields.label: Open tickets per member
fields.description: How many tickets a member can have open on this panel at once.

fields.label: Ticket channel name
fields.description: The name of new ticket channels, e.g. ticket-{number}. {topic} is the option label.

fields.label: Ask for a reason
fields.description: Show a form asking why the member needs help before the ticket opens.

readOnly.label: Status
readOnly.description: Whether the panel message is posted in a channel.

readOnly.label: Active tickets
readOnly.description: Tickets of this panel that are open, claimed or closed.

actions.label: Publish
actions.description: Posts the panel message in a channel, or updates it there. A message in another channel is deleted.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: A text or announcement channel the bot can post in.

actions.label: Update posted message
actions.description: Applies the saved panel (message, style and options) to the published message again.

automations.label: Automations
automations.description: When → If → Do rules: when something happens (a message, a reaction, a role change, a member joining, a button click…), check your conditions and run actions such as sending a message, giving roles, XP or coins. Shared with /automation in Discord, where you can also export and import them as JSON. The bot's permissions in the channels you pick are checked when it runs; "Check for problems" lists what went wrong.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Used by /automation in Discord. Renaming keeps its buttons working.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Preset
fields.description: Start from a ready-made recipe, or build your own.

options.label: Welcomer
options.description: When a member joins: post a welcome message in a channel, and optionally give a role.

options.label: Starboard
options.description: When a message gets enough reactions with an emoji: repost it in a channel.

options.label: Thread Joiner
options.description: When a thread is created (optionally only in one channel): add a member to it.

options.label: Commands Only
options.description: Keep a channel for commands: delete every message there that does not start with the prefix, except from staff.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Welcomer: where the welcome message is posted. Starboard: where popular messages are reposted (both: a text or announcement channel). Thread Joiner: only threads created in this channel (empty: every channel). Commands Only: the text or announcement channel to keep clean (the bot needs Manage Messages there).

fields.label: Welcome message
fields.description: Empty: "Hey {user}, welcome to **{server}**!"

fields.label: Role to give
fields.description: Optional. Below the bot's highest role, without moderator permissions.

fields.label: Emoji
fields.description: Empty: ⭐

fields.label: Member to add
fields.description: Added to every new thread (a person, not a bot).

fields.label: Staff role
fields.description: Optional. Members with it may still talk there, as do the moderator roles; with neither, staff messages are deleted too. The prefix and the moderator roles are read once: after changing them, create it again.

fields.label: When
fields.description: What starts it. Conditions and actions that do not fit the trigger are pointed out when you save.

options.label: Message sent
options.description: A member sends a message (bots and webhooks never trigger automations).

options.label: Message deleted
options.description: A member's message is deleted (deletions by the bot do not count).

options.label: Message edited
options.description: A member edits a message.

options.label: Button clicked
options.description: A member clicks a button that an automation posted.

options.label: Reaction added
options.description: A member reacts to a message.

options.label: Role gained
options.description: A member gets a role.

options.label: Role lost
options.description: A member loses a role.

options.label: Joined voice
options.description: A member joins a voice channel (moving counts as leaving one and joining the other).

options.label: Left voice
options.description: A member leaves a voice channel.

options.label: Thread created
options.description: A member creates a thread.

options.label: Member joined
options.description: A new member joins the server (bots do not count).

fields.label: If
fields.description: Every condition must pass (up to 10).
fields.emptyText: No conditions: it runs every time.

options.label: Channel is one of
options.description: It happened in one of these channels (or in a thread of one). Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Button clicked, Reaction added, Joined voice, Left voice, Thread created.

options.label: Channel is not one of
options.description: It happened outside these channels. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Button clicked, Reaction added, Joined voice, Left voice, Thread created.

options.label: Category is one of
options.description: It happened in a channel of one of these categories. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Button clicked, Reaction added, Joined voice, Left voice, Thread created.

options.label: Category is not one of
options.description: It happened outside these categories. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Button clicked, Reaction added, Joined voice, Left voice, Thread created.

options.label: Message contains words
options.description: The message contains at least one of these words (whole words, any case). Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Message is exactly
options.description: The whole message is one of these texts (any case). Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Message does not contain words
options.description: The message contains none of these words. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Message matches a regex
options.description: The message matches a regular expression. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Has an audio attachment
options.description: The message has an audio file attached. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Has an image attachment
options.description: The message has an image attached. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Has a video attachment
options.description: The message has a video attached. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Has a text-file attachment
options.description: The message has a text file attached (.txt, .md, .log, .csv, .json). Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Reacted with emoji
options.description: The reaction is one of these emojis. Works with: Reaction added.

options.label: Message has at least N reactions
options.description: The message has at least this many reactions. Works with: Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Message is a reply
options.description: The message replies to another message. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Message is not a reply
options.description: The message is not a reply. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Member has any of these roles
options.description: The member has at least one of these roles.

options.label: Member has all of these roles
options.description: The member has every one of these roles.

options.label: Member has none of these roles
options.description: The member has none of these roles.

options.label: Member lacks one of these roles
options.description: The member is missing at least one of these roles.

options.label: Gained one of these roles
options.description: The role the member got is one of these. Works with: Role gained.

options.label: Lost one of these roles
options.description: The role the member lost is one of these. Works with: Role lost.

options.label: User is one of
options.description: The member is one of these people.

options.label: Clicked this button
options.description: The clicked button is one of these automation buttons. Works with: Button clicked.

itemFields.label: Channels
itemFields.description: Threads count as their parent channel.

itemFields.label: Words
itemFields.description: Whole words or phrases, any case.

itemFields.label: Texts
itemFields.description: The whole message must be one of these (any case).

itemFields.label: Regular expression
itemFields.description: Without slashes, e.g. ^hello\b. Up to 200 characters; patterns that could hang (such as (a+)+) are refused.

itemFields.label: Only count this emoji
itemFields.description: Empty: every reaction counts.

itemFields.label: Buttons
itemFields.description: Automation buttons are posted by "Send a message", "Reply" or "Send a message in the thread" actions; each has a number shown on that action.

itemFields.label: Automation
itemFields.description: The name of the automation that posts the button (it may be this one).
itemFields.patternMessage: Type the name of an automation (letters, numbers, - and _).

fields.label: Do
fields.description: Run in order (up to 10).
fields.emptyText: No actions yet. Add at least one before turning it on.

options.label: Create a thread
options.description: Starts a thread on the message, or in a channel you pick.

options.label: Send a message
options.description: Posts a message where it happened or in a channel you pick.

options.label: Reply
options.description: Replies to the message (or to the button click, visible to everyone). Works with: Message sent, Message edited, Reaction added, Button clicked.

options.label: Repost the message
options.description: Copies the message into another channel, once per message. Works with: Message sent, Message deleted, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Pin the message
options.description: Pins the message. Works with: Message sent, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Delete the message
options.description: Deletes the message. Works with: Message sent, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: React with an emoji
options.description: Adds a reaction to the message. Works with: Message sent, Message edited, Reaction added.

options.label: Remove the reaction
options.description: Removes the reaction that triggered it, or one emoji you pick. Works with: Reaction added.

options.label: Give roles
options.description: Gives the member these roles.

options.label: Take roles
options.description: Takes these roles from the member.

options.label: Add members to the thread
options.description: Adds people to the thread (the member who triggered it when empty).

options.label: Send a message in the thread
options.description: Posts a message in the thread.

options.label: Give coins
options.description: Gives the member coins (needs the Economy module).

options.label: Take coins
options.description: Takes coins from the member (needs the Economy module).

options.label: Give XP
options.description: Gives the member XP (needs the Levels module).

options.label: Take XP
options.description: Takes XP from the member (needs the Levels module).

options.label: Send a saved embed
options.description: Posts one of your saved embeds.

itemFields.label: Message
itemFields.description: Up to 2,000 characters. Variables such as {user} and {message.link} are filled in.

itemFields.label: Button
itemFields.description: Optional: one link or automation button under the message.

options.label: Link
options.description: Opens a web page.

options.label: Automation button
options.description: Clicking it runs your "Button clicked" automations.

fields.label: Button number
fields.description: Given when you save (leave it empty for a new button). "Clicked this button" conditions use it.

itemFields.label: Channel
itemFields.description: Empty: the channel where it happened (pick one for triggers that happen outside a channel).

itemFields.label: Thread name
itemFields.description: Up to 100 characters; variables are filled in.

itemFields.label: Start it in
itemFields.description: Empty: a thread on the member's message. Pick a channel to start a new thread there instead.

itemFields.label: Emoji
itemFields.description: "Remove the reaction": empty removes the reaction that triggered it.

itemFields.label: Roles
itemFields.description: Roles below the bot's highest role, without moderator permissions.

itemFields.label: Members to add
itemFields.description: Empty: the member who triggered it.

itemFields.label: Saved embed
itemFields.description: The name of one of your saved embeds (Embed Messages).
itemFields.patternMessage: Type the name of a saved embed (lowercase letters, numbers, - and _).

fields.label: Cooldown per member
fields.description: How long before the same member can trigger it again (0 = no cooldown, up to 7 days).

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: it never runs.

actions.label: Check for problems
actions.description: Looks for deleted channels and roles, roles the bot cannot give, missing saved embeds, reward modules that are off, broken button links and the last error the bot ran into.
